measure: edge length of the container divided by the edge length of the pieces
format: per piece [c_1..c_4, S_12, S_13, ..., S_34, D_1..D_4]: the piece polytope of src/polytopes_nd.json (exact vertex coordinates V) placed as c + R V with R = diag(D) (I - S)^-1 (I + S), S skew-symmetric (upper triangle row by row, exact rationals), D = +-1 with determinant 1; container = s_full x mu x the container polytope of src/polytopes_nd.json, centred at the origin; planes [i, j, u_1..u_4, t]: u.x < t on piece i, u.x > t on piece j
method: d-dimensional soft-to-rigid homotopy (inscribed balls hardened into the polytope under inward pressure), basin hopping, sequential-LP tightening with per-pair separating hyperplanes (src/ndsim.py, src/ndslp.py)
title: 37 16-cells in a 16-cell
credit: soft-to-rigid method by Yohei Nakajima (2026); generalization to regular polytopes of dimensions 4-6, basin-hopping search and exact certification developed with Claude (Anthropic) under Alejandro Zarzuelo's direction
